Asha V: Noticed two OOMs on kv-pool-N last night during load test. crash log: "fatal error: runtime: out of memory". uploading pprof to s3://redwood/debug/kv/4895001234.tgz
Ben C: Can you capture alloc/inuse snapshots during the next canary? if alloc keeps increasing that's leaky live set; if inuse fragmented we may need slab metrics.
Lina T: I'll enable a conservative soft-heap-limit (72%) on the affected pool and enable ephemeral eviction TTL=45s. rolling now.
Jon P: I'll prototype a small Prom exporter for slab_free/slab_total and contiguous_free_ratio. Should give signal on fragmentation vs live growth. ETA 36h.
